findings.confidence: medium; one completed-delivery observation and visible recovery, no second handover reproduction
findings.title: Pausing immediately after handover can leave the next offer missing
findings.expected: A new offer becomes available after Resume without opening an unrelated menu.
findings.actual: After the +21 coin handover, P opened Paused before any offer appeared. Pause remained open while saving evidence. Resume showed Waiting for an order; a later capture still showed that state after the game clock advanced from 08:58 to 09:27. Pause > Change area > Stay here immediately restored a Royal Pizza House offer without relocation.
steps: Complete the normal pickup/customer route and hold E at the handover prompt.
Capture reward and immediately press P in the same tool call (1.85 seconds for the entire hold/capture/pause call).
Keep Paused open while saving evidence, longer than the 2.5 second callback delay.
Click Resume and observe without moving; no next offer appeared in the later screenshot.
Pause > Change area > Stay here; a new order offer appeared.
limitations: Single observed timing case; repeat after another normal handover before confirmation.
No direct callback/state inspection used; the exact completion-to-P interval was not separately instrumented.
A no-pause handover comparison is still required.
findings.nextStep: Repeat after a normal completed delivery, then compare with a handover without pausing. Keep this observed once until reproduced.
